title: Cordless (Cord-free) Vacuum Cleaners | Dyson India
content: Dyson cordless vacuums use powerful suction for deep cleaning. Models include V12s Detect Slim Submarine (wet and dry), V15 Detect, V12 Detect Slim Absolute, V11 Absolute, and V8 Absolute. Core technologies: HEPA filtration (captures 99.99% of particles at 0.1 microns), Hyperdymium™ motor (spins at up to 125,000rpm), Digital Motorbar™ cleaner head with de-tangling technology, No loss of suction. Up to 60 minutes of fade-free power.

title: Safeguard Home from Pollutants | Buy Air Purifier for Room | Dyson India
content: Dyson air purifiers monitor indoor air quality and capture 99.95% of microscopic particles. Key models: HushJet™ Purifier Compact (most powerful small-format), Dyson Purifier Hot+Cool™ HP02/HP12, Dyson Purifier Big+Quiet (BP02). Core technologies: 360° Electrostatic + Activated Carbon filters, Air Multiplier™ technology for long-range projection, fully sealed HEPA filtration, smart app connectivity, LCD screen for real-time AQI feedback.

title: Hair Care | Dryer, Straightener, Styler & Accessories | Dyson India
content: Dyson hair care technology uses less heat to prevent damage. Models: Airwrap™ multi-styler, Supersonic™ hair dryer, Corrale™ straightener, Airstrait™. Dyson Corrale uses flexing plates to shape hair with half the heat damage. Airstrait dries and straightens from wet. Features high-velocity airflow and digital motor V9 technology.

title: Dyson Airwrap™ multi-styler and dryer
content: Engineered for multiple hair types. Uses Coanda effect to curl, shape, and hide flyaways without extreme heat. Airwrap i.d.™ multi-styler (New Ceramic pink/Rose gold, Vinca Blue/Topaz). Features Intelligent heat control, 13-blade impeller motor. Attachments: 30mm/40mm barrels, firm/soft smoothing brushes, Coanda smoothing dryer.

title: Dyson hair dryers
content: Fast drying with controlled airflow. Dyson Supersonic Nural™: features scalp protect mode, attachment learning, and pause detect. Dyson Supersonic™: fast drying with no extreme heat. Powered by Digital Motor V9 (up to 110,000rpm). Air Multiplier™ technology triples airflow. Attachments: Flyaway attachment, Styling concentrator, Diffuser, Gentle air attachment.

title: Dyson V15 Detect vacuum cleaner
content: Dyson's most powerful, intelligent cordless vacuum. Suction power: 240AW. Laser Slim Fluffy™ cleaner head reveals invisible dust on hard floors. Piezo sensor continuously sizes and counts dust particles, automatically increasing suction when needed. LCD screen displays real-time scientific proof of a deep clean. Up to 60 minutes run time. Multi-stage filtration captures 99.99% of dust.

title: Dyson V12s Detect Slim Submarine™ complete wet and dry vacuum cleaner
content: All-in-one wet and dry cleaning solution. Submarine™ wet roller head washes hard floors with clean water. Detects invisible dust with laser illumination. Piezo sensor measures and counts dust particles. Compact and maneuverable. Includes motorized heads and specialized tools for whole-home cleaning. Lightest cordless vacuum with 150AW of suction.
